notes: Short vowel /ʌ/ as in up, umbrella, sun. Generate the word "Up." and keep only the vowel: cut just before the silence of the p (about 0.25 s). Never the letter name "you".
Stretchy sound. A clean hiss held for about 1 second, soft fade in and out. Never the letter name "ess". No vowel before or after.
Short vowel /æ/ as in ant, apple, cat. Generate the phrase, then trim to the vowel only (about 0.4 s). Never the letter name "ay" and no "uh" after it.
Stop sound. Generate the word "tap" and trim to the first ~100 ms so only the crisp, unvoiced t burst is left. No "tuh", never "tee". If it can't be made clean, record it by hand.
Stop sound. Generate the word "pan" and trim to the first ~100 ms: a soft puff of air, unvoiced. No "puh", never "pee". Record by hand if trimming fails.

Short vowel /ɪ/ as in ink, insect, pin. Generate the word "It." and keep only the vowel: cut just before the silence of the t (about 0.25 s). Never the letter name "eye" (a phrase starting with a lone "i" is read as "eye").
Stretchy sound. A hummed n held for about 1 second, mouth closed-ish, with soft fades and nothing after it. Never the letter name "en" and no "nuh".
